record.paper_title: 25 Open Questions About Vector Bundles and Their Moduli
record.original_question: Let X be a smooth connected n-dimensional manifold with n ≥ 2 such that h^i(O_X)=0 for 1 ≤ i ≤ n−1, and let A(X) be the set of ample line bundles L on X for which h^i(L^⊗t)=0 for all integers t and all 1 ≤ i ≤ n−1. Under what conditions is A(X) nonempty, and what is the dimension of A(X)?

evidence.quote: Notation 2.6. Let X be a smooth and connected n-dimensional manifold with n ≥ 2 such that h^i(OX) = 0 for all i = 1, . . . , n − 1. We denote by A(X) the set of all ample lines bundles L on X satisfying h^i(L^⊗t) = 0 for all t ∈ Z and all i = 1, . . . , n − 1. Question 6. Under what conditions is A(X) nonempty? What is dim A(X)?

artifact.category_tag: Ample line bundles and cohomology vanishing
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth connected complex projective manifold of dimension $n \geq 2$ satisfying $h^i(X, \mathcal{O}_X) = 0$ for every $1 \leq i \leq n-1$. Define $\mathcal{A}(X)$ to be the set of all ample line bundles $L$ on $X$ such that
\[
h^i(X, L^{\otimes t}) = 0 \quad \text{for all } t \in \mathbb{Z} \text{ and all } 1 \leq i \leq n-1.
\]
(i) Provide conditions on $X$ under which $\mathcal{A}(X)$ is nonempty. (ii) When $\mathcal{A}(X)$ is nonempty, determine its dimension (viewed inside the Néron–Severi or Picard group of $X$).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed as one of 25 open questions about vector bundles and their moduli. No published resolution of this specific question (characterizing nonemptiness and dimension of A(X)) appears in the literature; it remains open.
